summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the purchase of 5,000,000 ordinary shares on 5 June 2026 at a VWAP of 100.0735 pence, with a high of 101.00p and low of 99.38p. The purchases were executed through Goldman Sachs International as broker, under an existing share buyback programme announced on 30 January 2026. Shares will be cancelled, reducing outstanding equity. This is a routine open-market buyback under the issuer's standing programme, representing a capital return to shareholders without unusual structural features. No premium, tender, or fixed-price component is involved. Watch for ongoing buyback pace and impact on EPS.
